import os
import shutil
import time
import numpy as np
from task import motion_mask, synthetic

cache_dir = os.environ[\"CPPYY_KIT_CACHE_DIR\"]

def reference(t, xyz, enter_speed=0.08, exit_speed=0.04, hold_seconds=0.12):
    n = len(t)
    mask = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int32)
    candidate = -1
    active = False
    for i in range(1, n):
        delta = xyz[i] - xyz[i - 1]
        speed = np.sqrt(np.dot(delta, delta)) / (t[i] - t[i - 1])
        if active:
            if speed < exit_speed:
                active = False
                candidate = -1
            else:
                mask[i] = 1
        elif speed < enter_speed:
            candidate = -1
        else:
            if candidate < 0:
                candidate = i
            if t[i] - t[candidate] >= hold_seconds:
                active = True
                mask[i] = 1
    return mask

try:
    t, xyz = synthetic()
    expected = reference(t, xyz)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    got = motion_mask(t, xyz)
    first_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(got, expected)
    count = 7
    started = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(count):
        warm = motion_mask(t, xyz)
    warmed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000 / count
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(warm, expected)
    print(f\"samples={len(t)} equal=True dtype={got.dtype}\")
    print(f\"first_call_ms_including_compile={first_ms:.3f}\")
    print(f\"warmed_operation_ms_mean={warmed_ms:.3f} ({count} calls)\")
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(cache_dir, ignore_errors=True)
